articles.title: Bitcoin, ether slide after a hawkish Fed, even as Trump's signed Iran deal lifts stocks
articles.snippet: The Fed held rates but signaled it is more worried about inflation than growth in Chair Kevin Warsh's first meeting.

articles.title: Kentucky targets prediction markets, puts Trump-aligned state in potential clash with president's team
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump has taken the stance that states have no business with firms like Kalshi and Polymarket, and now a staunch GOP state is defying that view.

articles.title: Crypto market treads thin ice following Warsh FOMC, Trump Iran comments
articles.snippet: Markets wobbled after mixed comments from President Trump on the Iran peace deal and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh signaling a new direction from the Federal Reserve.
